Holder of the longest reign in UFC history, with 10 defenses, and often named one of the greatest MMA fighters of all time; he is in the UFC Hall of Fame.

The most successful sailor in Olympic history (medals at five Games, four golds in a row), with nine world titles and an America's Cup; the sport's global reach is smaller, so I propose legendary rather than mythic.

Record holder for world titles (6) and LCK titles (10), the first to win Worlds three times in a row, the first member of Riot's Hall of Legends and a cultural reference recognized even by the South Korean government.

Dominant in the discipline, with 11 Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series titles and two world golds; described as the most successful athlete in men's high diving. I did not propose mythic because the sport is niche and there is no evidence of cross-sport impact.
Record holder for top-division titles (45), undefeated titles (16) and career wins, with records recognized by Guinness; widely considered the greatest sumo wrestler in history.
Seven world titles, six European titles, world No. 1 with the right arm and East vs West super heavyweight champion; short evidence base (the Wikipedia article is a stub).
Five classical world titles, records for world rapid and blitz titles, the highest rating in history and the longest continuous reign as FIDE No. 1.
Men's record holder for Grand Slam titles (24), weeks at No. 1 (428) and ATP Finals (7), with Olympic gold and five Laureus awards; statistical dominance over almost two decades.

Ten IBJJF black-belt world titles, double gold and a superfight at ADCC, never submitted in 20 years of competition and the first member of the ADCC Hall of Fame; considered by many the greatest jiu-jitsu competitor in history.

Eight consecutive Mr. Olympia titles (a record shared with Lee Haney), 26 IFBB professional titles and often named the greatest bodybuilder in history. Proposed legendary rather than mythic because the record is shared and the sport has limited reach outside its community.

Six-time Lumpinee champion in four divisions, twice Fighter of the Year in Thailand and world champion with several bodies; often cited among the greatest in Muay Thai history. I did not propose mythic for lack of evidence of reach outside the sport.

The player with the most Age of Mythology S-Tier titles listed on Liquipedia (6) and the dominant player of the Retold era, but the scene is niche, with modest prize money and no institutional recognition outside the community.
15 majors, a record 82 PGA Tour wins and the only player to hold all four majors at once; he transformed the audience, the prize money and even the design of golf courses.
